## Event Validation & Routing
Validates incoming webhook requests, rejects invalid or unsupported events, and routes valid events to the appropriate invoice, payment, or refund flow.

## Refund Processing & Confirmation
Validates refund events, prevents duplicate refunds, records refund transactions, updates the invoice financial status, and sends a refund confirmation.

## Payment Processing & Confirmation
Validates payment events, prevents duplicate payments, records transactions, updates the invoice balance, and sends the appropriate payment confirmation or final paid notification.

## Invoice Creation & Delivery
Validates new invoice events, prevents duplicate invoices, stores invoice data, generates the PDF, sends it to the client, and returns the processing response.
